About $1,810, down 1.05% over 24 hours on CoinDesk's ticker (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia beat
themes.summary: Bitcoin edged up toward $64,000-$64,500 after Nvidia reported results above forecasts, following a session in which it fell about $1,000 in 30 minutes alongside tech stocks (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Options traders lean bearish
themes.summary: A $60,000 put became the largest Bitcoin options position on Deribit, with about $900 million in open interest, and puts made up six of the eight most-traded contracts (Stocktwits).

themes.title: Rate-hike bets weigh on crypto
themes.summary: Traders see about a 92% chance of a Fed rate increase in December, and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% (Stocktwits).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinking
themes.summary: The combined market cap of USDT, USDC, BUSD and DAI fell to about $250 billion, with supply down about 5% over 30 days (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Sentiment stays in extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index read 12, in extreme fear territory, up slightly from 10 a day earlier (Blocktalk).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both down about 1% to 1.4% over 24 hours on CoinDesk's ticker, with Bitcoin near $64,400 and Ether near $1,810 (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: Mixed: Solana rose 2.3% to about $73.58 and XRP 1.4% to about $0.97, while Hyperliquid (HYPE) fell 1.9% (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Major stablecoin supply near $250 billion, down about 5% in 30 days, a sign of less cash waiting on the sidelines (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Bitcoin ETFs
categories.note: Stocktwits reported a $68 million outflow from U.S. Bitcoin ETFs on Monday; an analyst quoted by CoinDesk said investors are hesitant to buy the dip (Stocktwits; CoinDesk).

watch_list.why: Minutes from the Fed's latest meeting are due Wednesday as markets price a likely December rate increase (Stocktwits; CoinDesk).
A Nansen analyst called this range the key test in coming weeks, and Wintermute's desk is watching $62,000, then $60,000 (Stocktwits).
Analysts are watching whether Bitcoin can reclaim its 200-week moving average, near $67,977 (Cointelegraph; CoinDesk).
